svg.title: UT Austin × Google.org AI for Science — System Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing the Google Cloud Control Plane (Cloud Run aurora-steer, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with gemini-4-argon, BigQuery, Dashboard), Backend 1 (TACC Vista/LoneStar6 Slurm with GENE and GX), Backend 2 (GCP Cloud Batch and GKE with C++ GX GPU and GX-JAX TPU), upstream ToBlick/mrx JAX MHD equilibria, shared GCS/$WORK dataset, and KR1/KR3 surrogate optimization loop.
svg.text: UT Austin × Google.org AI for Science — Platform Architecture
Transport-Consistent Optimization of High-Beta Stellarators · Automated Gyrokinetic Babysitting on TACC Slurm & Google Cloud GPU / TPU

g.text: GOOGLE CLOUD CONTROL PLANE (CLOUD RUN · GEMINI ENTERPRISE AGENT PLATFORM · BIGQUERY)

svg.text: Login Node Cron · Pure Python (0 Cloud/AI Deps) · Shared SchedulerBackend
Auto-resumes Slurm TIMEOUTs (0 LLM calls) · Client-side allowlist check & patchers
Slurm Compute Nodes (GENE Fortran + TACC GX)
High-Fidelity Gyrokinetic Validation · GH200 / CPU Partitions
Heavy NetCDF / HDF5 checkpoints stay local on $WORK · Compact diagnostics only

g.text: BACKEND 2: GCP CLOUD BATCH & GKE (SERVERLESS GPU & TPU)

svg.text: Cloud Run v2 Job (2m Scheduler) · Reuses SimulationWatchdog
Spot preemption auto-resume & OOM memory tier step-up (0 LLM calls)
Write-once dataset_eligible provenance · GCS FUSE mounts for .out.nc & .restart.nc
High-fidelity GENE validation queue (active learning → TACC)
